games.description: A brief solo investigation of the cursed village, cut short by camera, inventory, and interaction problems. Sark retries the opening and gas station before moving on.
games.title: Dawn of Hell

games.description: A short solo attempt at the opening underwater obstacle course. Sark wrestles with the camera and movement, experiments with the unused fart controls, and leaves the first stage unfinished before inspecting the trailer’s later environments.
games.title: FartGirl

games.description: A long solo journey through Nerea’s nightmare. Sark searches the city and sewers, survives the haunted houses and forest maze, reaches the party, and battles the timed driving finale across repeated attempts. The successful run was recorded during a Discord stream and later replayed on this Twitch stream, with the ending and his reactions preserved.
games.title: FOBIA ...worse than fear.

games.description: An unfinished solo visit to the psychiatric hospital. Sark learns the inventory and crafting system, searches for objectives while avoiding the doctor, and leaves after discovering that the main mission is not yet implemented.
games.title: Horror Explus

games.description: A solo attempt at the horror game now titled The House Sitter’s 5 Nights. Sark learns the chores, repeatedly encounters the ghost, survives the first night, and fails the longer second-night task list.
games.title: House Sitter

games.description: A solo playthrough of the available first chapter. Sark works through statue, machinery, candle, cage and colour puzzles, then reaches the chapter-ending cutscenes and reacts to the game’s increasingly bizarre presentation.
games.title: INHUMAN

games.description: Sark drives out to look for his missing brother, asks questions at the gas station and follows the mountain trail. A suspicious camp and cabin lead to the short horror ending.
games.title: Missing Hiker
